programme.title: Dirt
programme.desc: Atlanta is a city famous for vibrant art and tasty food, so for this episode the DIRT team went looking for the real people behind the scenes working to make this city so special. Josh meets celebrated chefs, barbers, farmers, and even a butter-wrapping machine dubbed André 4000 because he's "the second best 'wrapper' in Atlanta"—though special guest Killer Mike would probably take issue with that. Thirty years ago the real André announced to the world "the South got something to say," so tune in and listen up.

programme.title: Dirt
programme.desc: "Hope you're hungry. In this episode, come along as we eat our weight in sushi and ramen, meet nori farmers and wagyu ranchers, and make some new surfing buddies along the way. P.S. if you're hungry for more Japan content, stay tuned for our next two episodes. - In this episode of DIRT, the crew road tripped around Kyushu. The food culture in Kyushu dates back to the emperors of Japan, and the Black Current off the eastern shore has shaped the island's cuisine for centuries. The DIRT team followed that current up the coastline, surfing with new friends and tasting new flavors. And with each stop, we learned even more about how the traditions we keep can honor thousands of years of knowledge—and point the way to the future."

programme.title: Adventure Cities
programme.desc: Seasoned travel writer Jonathan Thompson travels to San José, Costa Rica, the lively capital city at the crossroads of culture and adventure. Jonathan dives deeper to uncover the region’s vibrant heart, capturing the rhythm of Independence Day celebrations, colorful street parades, and the charm of its historic neighborhoods. Venturing beyond the city, he explores the wild beauty that surrounds San José, from rafting the Pacuare River to hiking lush forests and visiting stunning waterfalls, discovering how this region perfectly embodies the true spirit of Costa Rica.

programme.title: Dirt
programme.desc: In Switzerland, everything you need is right in the backyard. That might be tough to believe while taking in the staggering peaks and powdery snow, but the DIRT crew learned it firsthand on their latest adventure. The key? The warmth and resourcefulness of the Swiss people. Josh and co got the lay of the land from chef Sarah Lämmli, foraging wild ramps, moss, and dried leaves on the outskirts of Lucerne. Then they worked their way up, carving lines into Interlaken’s ski slopes and learning how the locals thrive (and even make speakeasies out of ice) in the abundant mountain landscape.

What will the verdict be?

The search for the attacker leads to twists and turns, involving everyone from her talent manager to her labelmate. The truth about the night of the attack is slowly revealed, with unexpected consequences for all involved.

When Darron finally meets someone who seems genuine, his past mistakes come back with a vengeance. One of his exes' jealous boyfriends discovers their hidden affair, setting off a chain of events that spirals out of control.

To find the murderer, Lola must infiltrate the world that claimed Bunny’s life—a world of predatory regulars, backstage betrayals, and a cover-up that goes higher than she ever imagined.

But when two participants are found murdered, Trey’s world begins to crumble and things only begin to escalate.

Yet, her numbers aren’t improving, and she’s on the verge of being released from her contract. Her manager, suggests she returns to Atlanta and meet with a power house music producer to give her a refresh on her sound. programme.title: DUPR Collegiate National Championship
programme.desc: The atmosphere turns electric as the University of Florida and the University of North Carolina clash in a high-stakes pursuit of the 2023 DUPR Collegiate National Championship. With standout athletes like Brayden Drake delivering relentless energy, every rally becomes a testament to the "heat" these programs bring to the court. This episode showcases the full spectrum of collegiate pickleball, from high-speed Racing rallies to the precision of technical Skills and the flair of Freestyle play that keeps the opposition guessing. As the scoreline tightens at critical junctions like 15-13 and 20-16, the pressure reaches a fever pitch where only the most composed "Game boy" can lead their team to glory.

programme.desc: Beth Bellamy & Yates Johnson compete with Megan Fudge & Paul Olin in a Bronze medal match

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.desc: The intensity reaches a fever pitch in Saint Louis as the NCPA Nationals move into a high-stakes, single-elimination "win or go home" format. The University of Florida Gators face a monumental challenge on Center Court against a "powerhouse" Utah Tech team featuring international pro talent. Watch as players like Lauren Mercado and Andres Tardio utilize elite "Skills" to navigate high-speed exchanges and strategic "Racing" sprints to the kitchen line. With their tournament lives on the line, both programs deliver a "Freestyle" display of collegiate athleticism that proves why every point in the bracket matters.

programme.title: NPL
programme.desc: The Denver Iconics take on the Oklahoma City Punishers in a women's NPL team match.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2025
programme.desc: This Men's Senior Pro Doubles match from the US Open 2025 features the team of Schiller and Weinbach battling Bronson and Coker. programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.desc: NCPA Quarterfinals: Utah Valley vs Virgina in the 2025 NCPA Championships from Las Vegas.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.desc: The atmosphere at the Arch Pickleball Center reaches a fever pitch as Utah Valley and LSU clash in a high-stakes, sudden-death battle for survival. This elite matchup showcases the "Racing" speed of Ethan Martin against the tactical "Skills" of Rachel Gauff in a contest where every point determines who advances in the bracket. With a $1,000 bounty on the line, both teams engage in a fierce "Freestyle" display of collegiate athleticism that proves why new powerhouses are emerging on the national stage.

programme.title: DUPR Collegiate Super Regional
programme.desc: Witness the high-stakes intensity of the season's first college super regional as the Ohio State Buckeyes take on the Indiana Hoosiers in a premier semifinal matchup. Experience the inspiring athleticism on display as top-tier competitors like Devin battle through every point in this high-energy "Beehive State" rivalry. With regional pride and a spot in the finals on the line, this match captures the relentless spirit and tactical depth that define collegiate pickleball at the highest level.

programme.title: DUPR Collegiate Super Regional
programme.desc: The atmosphere is electric at Pickle and Social in Buford, Georgia, as two collegiate titans clash for the regional title. The Florida Gators and North Carolina Tar Heels bring intense firepower and strategic brilliance to the court in a series of high-stakes doubles matches. With the championship on the line, every dink and drive counts as these elite athletes fight to cement their legacy on the Collegiate Pickleball Tour.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.desc: The intensity reaches a boiling point in Saint Louis as the NCPA Nationals transition to a high-stakes, single-elimination "win or go home" format. The University of South Florida Bulls and the Kansas Jayhawks take center stage in a best-of-seven battle where every point feels like a "Racing" sprint toward the championship crown. Watch as Austin King and Tessa Wilson utilize elite "Skills" to navigate a narrow center court, fending off a late-game surge by the Jayhawks to secure a hard-fought 11-8 victory. With the bracket tightening and powerhouses like Penn State and Michigan looming, this "Freestyle" display of collegiate talent proves that in the world of elite pickleball, there is zero room for error.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2024
programme.desc: In this thrilling gold medal match from the 2024 US Open Pickleball Championships, Dylan Frazier and Altaf Merchant take on defending champions Andrei Daescu and Dave Weinbach in the Men’s Split Pro Doubles division. The action heats up fast as Frazier and Merchant dominate early, only to be met with a fierce comeback from Daescu and Weinbach in game two. Momentum swings, net-cord drama, and tactical shifts lead to an electrifying third game where every point counts.From Frazier’s lightning-fast hands to Daescu’s towering net play, this match showcases elite shot-making, sharp strategy, and high emotion on Championship Court. With the crowd on edge and the gold medal on the line, it’s a true masterclass in professional pickleball.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.desc: Experience the high-octane energy of the NCPA Nationals in Saint Louis as the LMU Lions and Baylor Bears battle in a high-stakes best-of-seven series. The competition ignites with the Racing speed of rapid-fire volleys during an intense "equipment battle" between the power of the Selkirk Boomstick and the precision of Team Joola. Masterful Skills are on display as athletes execute flawless Around the Post (ATP) winners and tactical dink rallies that keep the pressure mounting. Amidst the Freestyle creativity of the collegiate circuit, witness morale-shifting momentum swings and desperate scrapping for every point as these top-tier programs fight for national dominance.

programme.title: DUPR Collegiate Super Regional
programme.desc: The legendary Big Ten rivalry enters the pickleball arena as the Wisconsin Badgers and Indiana Hoosiers clash in a high-stakes playoff battle at the 2025 DUPR Collegiate Ohio Super Regional. With four coveted bids to the National Championships on the line, elite athletes like Wisconsin’s Noah Havlik and Indiana’s Carter Maris engage in high-octane doubles matches defined by "majestic sorcery" and explosive power. Witness the intensity of collegiate rally scoring where every dink, drive, and around-the-post winner determines which team will punch their ticket to the season finale in April.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2023
programme.desc: Catch all the action from the Women's Senior Pro Doubles Semifinal 1 at the 2023 US Open Pickleball Championships held in Naples, Florida. This semifinal match features top senior pros Nathalie Bagby and Beth Bellamy facing Jennifer Dawson and Bonnie Williams in a high-stakes contest. Expert commentary highlights key strategies, player strengths, and match dynamics including powerful serves from Ava Welsher, tactical lobs, and intense court positioning. Follow how the players adjust to crowd pressure and timeouts in this best-of-three game format. Get ready for a thrilling showdown in one of pickleball’s premier senior pro events.

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.desc: Experience the electric intensity of the "Maharashtra derby" as local rivals Pune United and Mumbai Pickle Power clash at the Jio World Garden in a match hailed as one of the season's best. Mumbai ignites the home crowd with a dominant early lead, fueled by Jada Bui’s emotional victory over a "fearful" Katie Morris and a clinical masterclass from Brandon and Glauca Carvajal Lane in mixed doubles. However, the tide turns in a dramatic "tale of two halves" as Pune United mounts a stunning comeback. Witness the high-power precision of Bolin Bako as he derails Max Green’s momentum, sparking a relentless surge that sees Pune sweep the final three matches to snatch victory from the jaws of defeat. This tie is a masterclass in team resilience and tactical pressure under the lights in Mumbai.

programme.title: Picklebowl 2023
programme.desc: Dylan Frazier and Ritchie Tuazon meet Irina Tereschenko and Connor Pardoe in a high-stakes mixed doubles match at Picklebowl 2023. Set against the backdrop of this annual charity event, the match features four seasoned competitors known for their precision, quick reflexes, and court awareness. Expect fast-paced exchanges, smart teamwork, and big momentum swings as both teams battle for bragging rights and a good cause. Blending professional play with the spirited energy of Picklebowl, this match is a crowd favorite you won’t want to miss.

programme.title: 7 Miles of Paradise
programme.desc: The North Shore is a 7 Mile stretch of paradise like no other on Earth. Every year thousands of people flock to the North Shore of Oahu to see the world's best surfers ride arguably the world's best waves. Pro surfers have created their careers, made their livings and even become legends from surfing these shores. Pro surfer Anastasia Ashley will be your tour guide and take you to the places she loves, the places she went as a kid growing up there, and introduce you to the people that always made it feel like home. We will experience and understand why she loves the North Shore, and considers it '7 Miles of Paradise'

programme.title: The Essence of Surfing
programme.desc: The Essence of Surfing is a riveting surf documentary that gets to the heart of why surfing is the greatest sport in the world. Featuring surfers of all kinds, from the neighborhood grom to some of the greatest surfers to ever live, The Essence of Surfing uncovers what it is about this awesome sport that makes it a necessary part of each of their lives. Shot in the world's most beautiful locations by top notch Cinematographers Erik Ippel and Mike Prickett, this film is sure to hook and inspire anyone looking to get wet and catch some waves.
